variants.title: Dielectric constant of PTFE (Teflon)
variants.note: A non-polar solid: no relaxation inside the meter's range, so the dielectric constant is flat from 100 Hz to 1 MHz.

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, 'Permittivity (dielectric constant) of materials': PTFE 2.1, polystyrene 2.55, fused silica 3.78, Pyrex glass 4.6
